decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Drawing numbers: 29501 and 29501, recieved 7 January 2010; and
29503 and 29504, both Rev A, recieved 15 February 2010

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and and none shall take place on Saturdays, Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern or western wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 90 Heston Road].
description: Erection of a two-storey part side and part rear extension and a ground floor rear extension
